snippet.title: Miko-san's Miracle Board [みこさんのミラクルボード] Game Sample - PC/Doujin
snippet.description:
Developed in 2002 by PowerWinds, the same people who developed Tondemo Houki 2, it features the same heroine from TH2 and a similar premise, but a very different engine. Utilizing basic 3D graphics, your goal is simple; just get from Point-A to Point-B in one piece. You can collect red ribbons and rings/coins like in TH2 and must avoid course traps and/or defeat enemies along the way. Miko-san rides a board with a picture of her outrageous broom; it features various techniques and aerial prowess similar to the broom as well. As such, there is a rather indepth Tutorial (Practice) Mode included with the other basic modes; it's not as long as TH2, but there's still much to learn.

Miko-san can utilize several jumping and boosting techniques. Boosting consumes a little energy but allows you to move faster and jump farther (rings restore some boost energy and allow her to temporarily boost faster, good for aerial ring trails). Miko-san can also hold back to slow down and charge her boost gauge (as well as have less cumbersome controls dropping off certain slopes). Miko-san can even attack enemies with boosts and some good timing; if she is hit by enemies or obstacles three times, she'll lose a life. The game isn't as fun as TH2 and the camera and controls can prove a bit much at times, but it's still an interesting diversion, albeit rather simple (the stages are technically a lot easier and you can take some ridiculous shortcuts if you aren't collecting anything). This video shows some stuff in the game. The game is now free-- you can get the game at:

http://www.vector.co.jp/download/file/win95/game/fh310532.html

Enjoy.
